decisions.reason: As a close-to-core service that reinforces the firm's agency-focused support positioning, premium customer support likely met aspiration levels well enough and the firm's growth, hiring, and broad portfolio provide slack to retain it.

The version management tool builds directly on the firm's hosting and administration capabilities and was still being actively referenced in 2019, so under behavioral-theory logic it is more likely to stay unless later results clearly fell below aspiration.

Because the data-processing-contract tool is relatively distant from the core hosting business, management would be more likely to redeploy resources away from it if its performance was uncertain or below aspiration despite the firm's moderate slack.

Scalable hosting for agencies is close to the established business, was presented as a flagship direction, and fits industry growth and the firm's core strengths, so it is very likely to remain on the market.
